papers.title: An aberrant precision account of autism

aura_parameter_mapping.mechanistic_link: Formalizes autism as elevated bottom-up sensory precision (pi_sensory) relative to top-down prior precision (pi_prior) in hierarchical cortical predictive coding. High-entropy social crowds generate unattenuated prediction errors, causing allostatic sensory saturation that standard psychometric inventories misclassify as low Extraversion (-24% E) or low Agreeableness (-12% A). Directly parameterizes Aura's `monotropic_sensory_precision` mask and the `dyadic_1on1_capacity = clamp(debiased_scores['E'] + social_unmask)` de-confounding equation.

Establishes that tonic and phasic striatal dopamine do not merely signal scalar reward, but encode the precision (gamma) of beliefs over policies and action affordances. In an interest-based nervous system (`adhd_dopamine_forager`), low tonic dopamine yields low policy precision on low-salience routine tasks (-22% C prior offset), whereas high intrinsic salience/novelty triggers phasic dopamine bursts that sharply elevate gamma, unlocking hyperfocus (`salience_locked_drive = clamp(debiased_scores['C'] + 34.0)`).

papers.title: Introducing a Bayesian model of selective attention based on active inference

aura_parameter_mapping.mechanistic_link: Models selective attention as precision optimization (zeta) over likelihood mappings A(o|s) driven by cholinergic/noradrenergic gain. Explains how narrow, high-precision attentional tunnels (Monotropism) and amplified perceptual signal resolution (`hsp_high_gain_sensor`, +24% `perceptual_gain_to_volatility_confound`) arise from localized likelihood precision, and why standard tests mistake high perceptual resolution for emotional volatility (`true_dysregulation = clamp(debiased_scores['N'] - perceptual_unmask * 0.75)`).

papers.title: Computational psychiatry: from synapses to sentience

aura_parameter_mapping.mechanistic_link: Synthesizes how ascending neuromodulatory systems (ACh, NE, DA, 5-HT) set synaptic gain (precision weighting) across cortical hierarchies, separating fast, state-dependent affective fluctuations (`S_state(mood_energy, self_criticism)` weighted by `mood_susceptibility` lambda in [0.08, 0.65]) from slow structural priors (`cortical_invariant` vs `neuromodulatory_gain`).
